scripts.build: bun run --filter @querykitjs/core build && bun run --filter @querykitjs/zod build && bun run --filter @querykitjs/class-validator build && bun run --filter @querykitjs/drizzle-pg build && bun run --filter @querykitjs/prisma-pg build && bun run --filter @querykitjs/mongoose build && bun run --filter @querykitjs/web build
scripts.test:conformance: bun run packages/core/test/conformance/self-check.ts && bun run packages/drizzle-pg/test/conformance.ts && bun run packages/prisma-pg/test/conformance.ts && bun --preload ./packages/mongoose/test/_bun-v8-shim.ts packages/mongoose/test/conformance.ts && bun --preload ./packages/mongoose/test/_bun-v8-shim.ts packages/web/test/conformance.ts
scripts.release: bun run build && node scripts/pin-workspace-deps.mjs && node scripts/ci-publish.mjs
